importantNonImplications: A visible inherited JavaScript method is not supported merely because the package bundles.
Successful Node-host tests using Node dependencies are oracle evidence, not guest adapter proof.
HighWaterMark is a backpressure threshold, not a hard memory limit; proposed queue/byte/work bounds need separate versioned validation.
Source and syntax acceptance of private ticks are not runtime scheduler acceptance.
No new node:process/global process or host capability is proposed.
